message: The other day, I was rummaging through a closet when I stumbled upon our old go-bags. I’d packed them ages ago, thinking they’d be just one of those ‘nice-to-have’ things. But then, as fate would have it, we had a minor plumbing issue that required us to stay with my daughter for a few days. Having those bags ready with essentials like snacks, toiletries, and important documents made the transition so much smoother. It felt like a little victory in an unexpected moment. Isn’t it nice when preparedness pays off in small ways?
